description: This file defines the 'CodeOmr' class in the PdfSharp.Drawing.BarCodes namespace, representing an OMR (Optical Mark Recognition) barcode type, with rendering logic and configurable properties.

classes.name: CodeOmr
classes.description: A class representing an OMR barcode, derived from BarCode, with rendering capabilities and configurable properties for synchronization, marker distance, and thickness.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Overrides the base method to draw the OMR code with specific rotation and marker drawing logic, depending on the code's direction.

methods.name: CheckCode
methods.description: Validates the provided text for the OMR code, currently implemented as an empty override.
